research.title: Robustness Evaluation of Road Scene Segmentation
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare segmentation models under synthetic fog, brightness shifts, and image blur using matched evaluation conditions.
Implemented corruption pipelines and examined classwise intersection over union, documenting boundary errors and sensitivity to preprocessing choices.

research.title: Augmentation Strategies for Imbalanced Surface Defect Recognition
bullets: Planned experiments with supervisor guidance to compare class weighting and image augmentation for surface defect classification under imbalanced training distributions.
Trained convolutional baselines using specimen separated data splits, analyzing per class recall and confusion patterns across augmentation settings.

publications.title: Comparing Class Weighting and Image Augmentation for Imbalanced Surface Defect Recognition

work.title: Image Upload Validation and Processing Maintenance
bullets: Implemented assigned validation checks for uploaded images, handling unsupported formats, inconsistent dimensions, and corrupted files within an existing processing service.
Added regression tests for image conversion routines and investigated processing failures using application logs and reproducible input cases.

projects.title: Local Feature Matching for Image Alignment
bullets: Implemented corner detection and patch descriptors, then compared matching behavior against an established feature baseline on transformed image pairs.
Evaluated alignment using reprojection error and inlier consistency, inspecting failures caused by repeated textures, viewpoint changes, and weak image contrast.

projects.title: Transfer Learning for Small Image Classification Datasets
bullets: Implemented frozen feature extraction and partial fine tuning of a pretrained convolutional model using identical training and validation splits.
Compared classification accuracy, training behavior, and confusion matrices against a compact model trained from scratch, documenting sensitivity to augmentation choices.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Image Denoising Methods
bullets: Implemented Gaussian, median, and bilateral filtering for images corrupted by Gaussian and impulse noise under a shared evaluation pipeline.
Compared peak signal to noise ratio and structural similarity, examining how filter parameters affected edge preservation and residual noise.
